subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned locked PR-limit announcement remain open now that the 20-PR cap is documented and enforced on main?
rationale: The implementation evidence is complete, but the recent maintainer reopen/pin signal is a communication-surface decision that cleanup automation should not override.

options.title: Keep the notice open
options.body: Leave the issue pinned and locked as the public contributor-policy explanation for people who hit the cap.

options.title: Close as notice complete
options.body: Close the issue and rely on CONTRIBUTING.md plus the automation close comment for future contributors.

options.title: Move to a maintained discussion
options.body: Replace the issue with a docs or discussion pointer, then close it once the new public surface exists.

recommendation.title: Keep the notice open
recommendation.body: Leave the issue pinned and locked as the public contributor-policy explanation for people who hit the cap.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman performed the recent rename, reopen, and pin actions that most directly express the announcement lifecycle decision.
